# eprdados

Conjuntos de dados para o ensino de Ecologia de Paisagens.

Datasets for teaching landscape Ecology.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `eprdados` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

Você pode instalar o pacote `eprdados` através do comando:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("darrennorris/eprdados")
```

## Example

![](reference/figures/README-mapa-tematica-1.png)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

This is a basic example which shows you how to make a map with the data
in the package:

``` r

library(eprdados)
library(tmap)
mapbiomas_2020 <- rast(utm_cover_AP_rio_2020)

# Reclassificação - 
# Criar uma nova camada de floresta (novo objeto de raster copiando mapbiomas_2020, 
# assim para ter os mesmos coordenados, resolução e extensão)
floresta_2020 <- mapbiomas_2020
# Todos os pixels com valor de 0
values(floresta_2020) <- 0
# Atualizar com valor de 1 quando pixels originais são de floresta (classe 3 e 4)
floresta_2020[mapbiomas_2020==3 | mapbiomas_2020==4] <- 1 
# Passo necessario para agilizar o processamento
floresta_2020_modal <- aggregate(floresta_2020, 
                                 fact=10, 
                                 fun="modal")
# pontos cada 5 km
rio_pontos_31976 <- rio_pontos |> 
  st_transform(31976) 
# linha central de rios
rio_linhacentral_31976 <- rio_linhacentral |> 
  st_transform(31976)

# Mapa
tm_shape(floresta_2020_modal) +
  tm_raster(style = "cat", 
            palette = c("0" = "#E974ED", "1" ="#129912"), legend.show = FALSE) + 
  tm_add_legend(type = "fill", labels = c("não-floresta", "floresta"),
    col = c("#E974ED", "#129912"), title = "Classe") + 
tm_shape(rio_linhacentral_31976) + 
  tm_lines(col="blue") + 
tm_shape(rio_pontos_31976) + 
  tm_dots(size = 0.2, col = "yellow") + 
tm_layout(legend.bg.color="white")
```

Package developed and built using the following guides:

- Fan Wang:
  <https://fanwangecon.github.io/PkgTestR/articles/ffv_pkgdown_github.html>
  and

- Emil Hvitfeldt:
  <https://emilhvitfeldt.com/post/2018-09-02-usethis-workflow-for-package-development/>
  and

- Saskia O:
  <https://www.marinedatascience.co/blog/2020/01/09/checklist-for-r-package-re-submissions-on-cran/>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`UHE_Ferreira_Gomes`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/UHE_Ferreira_Gomes.md)
  : Ferreira Gomes dam
- [`amcel`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/amcel.md)
  : AMCEL plantation
- [`amostra_mapbiomas_2020`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/amostra_mapbiomas_2020.md)
  : A small sample of MapBiomas Collection 6 data
- [`amostras_metrica`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/amostras_metrica.md)
  : Landscape metric around a point.
- [`barragens`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/barragens.md)
  : Dams and reservoirs
- [`carnivoros`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/carnivoros.md)
  : Carnivore species and landscape metrics.
- [`entrevistas`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/entrevistas.md)
  : Interview locations.
- [`floresta_2020`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/floresta_2020.md)
  : MapBiomas Collection 6 forest cover.
- [`forest_cover_interviews`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/forest_cover_interviews.md)
  : Forest cover landscape metrics.
- [`interview_species_metrics`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/interview_species_metrics.md)
  : Species and landscape metrics.
- [`marco_zero_2026_31982`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/marco_zero_2026_31982.md)
  : Marco Zero
- [`rio_linhacentral`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/rio_linhacentral.md)
  : Centerline of river channels.
- [`rio_pontos`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/rio_pontos.md)
  : Sample points along rivers.
- [`rio_pontos_31976`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/rio_pontos_31976.md)
  : Sample points along rivers, ESPG: 31976.
- [`rio_pontos_buff`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/rio_pontos_buff.md)
  : Buffers around sample point along rivers.
- [`utm_cover_AP_rio_2020`](https://darrennorris.github.io/eprdados/reference/utm_cover_AP_rio_2020.md)
  : A sample of MapBiomas Collection 6 data
